bias_check.principle: Markets price expectations, not your conviction — weigh valuation, the macro and the data, not just the story.

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: Management proposes exploring strategic partnerships and alternative funding avenues to support capacity expansion and market reach.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Additionally, exploring strategic partnerships and alternative funding avenues is proposed to support capacity expansion and market reach." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company recorded total income of Rs. 4,246.65 Lakhs for FY25, achieving 25% growth over the previous year.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "During the financial year ended 31st March 2025, the Company’s total income stood at Rs. 4,246.65 Lakhs, registering a growth of 25% as compared to Rs. 3,393.29 Lakhs in the previous financial year." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The board did not recommend any dividend for FY25 due to losses incurred during the financial year.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "During the financial year under review, the Company has incurred losses, therefore no dividend has been recommended by the Board." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company did not buy back any of its securities during the year under review.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "The Company has not bought back any of its securities during the year under review" (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The increase in net loss was caused by higher raw material costs without matching sales price increases, as well as a notional fair value loss adjustment on investments.
opportunities.evidence: Margins / costs: "The increase in loss on account of increased raw material costs without corresponding increase in the sales price as well on account of adjustment of notional fair value loss on the investments." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The loss for the financial year ended March 31, 2025 stood at Rs. 320.79 Lakhs compared to a loss of Rs. 60.04 Lakhs in the prior year.
opportunities.evidence: Margins / costs: "The loss for the year was Rs 320. 79 lacs as against a loss of Rs. 60.04 lacs." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The company periodically reviews its cyber security maturity and enhances processes and technology controls in response to increased cyber attack scenarios.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "In view of increased cyber attack scenarios, the cyber security maturity is reviewed periodically and the processes, technology controls are being enhanced in-line with the threat scenarios." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: The company did not experience any cyber security incidents, breaches, or data losses during the year under review.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "During the year under review, your Company did not face any incidents or breaches or loss of data breach in cyber security." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S21/W9/O9/T13), led by 'The technical block scores well', with 31 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
